posts.title: Would you trust AI to book your estimates?
posts.text: I've been testing AI phone answering for my brother's landscaping company. Getting it to answer questions is one thing, but letting it put appointments on the calendar is another. There are jobs we don't take, and the last thing I want is an estimate booked for something we don't even do. Would you let AI book estimates, or would you rather have it take the information and call the customer back?

posts.title: Anyone have a business use endorsement on their personal policy?
posts.text: Was talking to another insurance agent and he seems to think the business use endorsement policy will be denied if i get into an accident. posts.text: Curious how other solo and small crews handle this. When I talk to guys running one or two trucks, the thing that comes up most isn't mowing time, it's the driving in between. posts.title: How I keep T&M change orders from turning into argument invoices
posts.text: How I keep T&M change orders from turning into argument invoices Every GC I know has lost money on a "quick" T&M change that somehow became a fight three weeks later.
